title: Generic artifact schema
description: Base schema for all artifacts validated by the deterministic orchestration harness. Methodology-specific artifact schemas in schemas/ extend this base. The harness is agnostic to the methodology that owns the artifact; this base only supplies the generic object shape and a minimal set of helper definitions that are truly universal across artifact schemas.

id.description: Stable artifact identifier. The exact format is owned by the methodology-specific schema; the base only requires it to be a non-empty string when present.

slug.description: URL-safe artifact slug. Methodology-specific schemas may impose additional constraints (length, format); the base only requires it to be a non-empty string.

nonEmptyString.description: Reusable helper: a string with at least one character.

nullableString.description: Reusable helper: a string or null.

stringArray.description: Reusable helper: an array of strings.
